payload.core_mechanism_summary: Tree DP: compute subtree university count via post-order traversal, then sum min(subtree_count, 2k-subtree_count) over edges to maximize total pairing distance.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a single post-order DFS, accumulating subtree counts and adding edge contributions using a known optimal pairing trick. This is classic tree DP for maximizing sum of distances in pairs.
